Requirements for Installation and Luminous Intensity of Daytime Running Lamp for the
Micro Vehicle (Article 38-4 Paragraph 3)

1. Installation requirementsA. Installation position1) Width
A) One independent daytime running lamp may be installed on the upper, lower, left and right
of another front lamp, and if another front lamp is installed in vertical direction, the
reference point of the daytime running lamp shall be located within the median longitudinal
plane of the micro vehicle, and if installed in horizontal direction, the reference points of
these lamps shall be respectively symmetrical to the median longitudinal plane of the micro
B) One daytime running lamp reciprocally incorporated with another front lamp shall be
located within the median longitudinal plane of the micro vehicle. However, if the daytime
running lamps are installed with another front lamp at horizontal positions, the reference
points of these lamps shall be respectively symmetrical to the median longitudinal plane of
the micro vehicle
C) If two daytime running lamps are installed, the reference point of these headlamps shall be
symmetrical to the median longitudinal plane of the micro vehicle
D) If the overall width of the micro vehicle exceeds 1,300 mm, the minimum distance of the
apparent surfaces of daytime running lights shall be not less than 500 mm
2) Height
Not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground
3) Length
Daytime running lamp shall be positioned in the front of the micro vehicle, and it shall be
structured to not cause any distraction to the driver directly/indirectly with the reflecting part
of the vehicle or rearview mirror when switched ON
B. If the distance between daytime running lamp and direction indication lamp are not more than
40 mm, the daytime running lamp installed on each side shall be switched OFF during the
operation of direction indication lamp or be reduced to 140 cd or less.
C. Observation angle
1) The visibility of the apparent surface of the daytime running lamp shall be ensured in any
angle of not more than 10 degrees upwards and downwards
2) For the single lamp, the visibility of apparent surface for daytime running lamp shall be
ensured in any angle of not more than 20 degrees leftward and rightward. If two lamps are
installed, the visibility of apparent surface for daytime running lamp shall be ensured in any
angle of not more than 20 degrees outwards and 20 degrees inwards
D. Orientation
The illuminating direction of the lamp shall be towards the front of the vehicle. However, it may
move according to the angle of the steering wheel
E. Operation requirements
1) The daytime running lamp shall be switched ON automatically when the engine is started.
However, the daytime running lamps may remain OFF while any one of the following
conditions exist.
A) The automatic transmission control is in the park position; or
B) The parking brake is in the applied position; or


<!-- Page 376 -->

© KAIDA
376
KMVSS (Korea Motor Vehicle SafetyStandards)MOLIT Ordinance No. 1520 (2025.08.14)

삭제함: No. 1499 (2025.05.30)
C) Prior to the vehicle being set in motion for the first time after engine on.
2) The daytime running lamps may be switched OFF manually when the vehicle speed does not
exceed 10 km/h provided they switch ON automatically when the vehicle speed exceeds 10
km/h or when the vehicle has travelled more than 100 m and they remain ON until deliberately
switched off again.
3) The daytime running lamps shall remain OFF while any one of the following conditions exist.
A) If the vehicle is stopped by the ignition key
B) If the front fog lamp is switched ON
C) If the headlamp is switched ON, except that the driving beam of headlamp is used
momentarily for the purpose of warning
F. The tell-tale to indicate the operation statue of the daytime running lamp may be installed

2. The luminous intensity shall meet the requirements under Subparagraph 2 in Table 6-8

Requirements for Installation and Luminous Intensity of Reversing Lamp for the Micro
Vehicle (Article 39 Subparagraph 3)

1. Installation requirementsA. Installation position1) Width
If two are installed, they shall be symmetrical to the median longitudinal plane of the micro
2) Height
Not less than 250 mm and not more than 1200 mm above the ground.
B. Observation angle
1) The visibility of the apparent surface of the reversing lamp shall be ensured in any angle of
not more than 15 degrees upwards, 5 degrees downwards
2) The visibility of single lamp shall be ensured in any angle of not more than 45 degrees for
leftward and rightward. If two are installed, the visibility shall be ensured in any angle of not
more than 45 degrees outwards, 30 degrees inwards
C. Orientation
The illuminating direction for the reversing lamp shall be towards the rear of the vehicle.
D. Operation requirements
The lamp can light up only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the
starting and stopping of the engine is in such a position that operation of the engine is possible.
E. The tell-tale to indicate the operation statue of the reversing lamp may be installed

2. The luminous intensity shall meet the requirements under Subparagraph 2 in Table 6-10

Requirements for Installation and Luminous Intensity of Position Lamp for The Micro
Vehicle (Article 40 Subparagraph 3)

1. Installation requirementsA. Installation position1) Width
A) One independent position lamp shall be possible to be installed on the upper, lower, left
and right sides of another front lamp. If another front lamp is installed in vertical direction,
the reference point of the position lamp shall be located within the median longitudinal
plane of the micro vehicle, and if installed in horizontal direction, the reference points of
these lamps shall be respectively symmetrical to the median longitudinal plane of the micro
B) One position lamp reciprocally incorporated with another front lamp shall be located within
the median longitudinal plane of the micro vehicle. However, if the position lamps are
installed with another front lamp at horizontal positions, the reference points of these lamps
shall be respectively symmetrical to the median longitudinal plane of the micro vehicle
C) If two position lamps are installed, the reference point of these lamps shall be symmetrical
to the median longitudinal plane of the micro vehicle
D) If two position lamps are installed, the extreme outer edge on the apparent surface shall
not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
2) Height
Not less than 350 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
B. Observation angle
1) The visibility of the apparent surface of the position lamp shall be ensured in any angle of not
more than 15 degrees upwards and 15 degrees downwards. However, if the reference axis of
the position lamp is less than 750 mm above the ground, the visibility of the apparent surface
shall be ensured in any angle of not more than 5 degrees downwards
2) The visibility of single lamp shall be ensured in any angle of not more than 80 degrees
leftwards and rightwards. If two are installed, the visibility shall be ensured in any angle of
not more than 80 degrees outwards, 45 degrees inwards
C. Orientation
The illuminating direction of the lamp shall be towards the front of the vehicle. However, it may
move according to the angle of the steering wheel
D. Operation requirements
The position lamp shall be structured to switch ON and OFF simultaneously with the rear
position lamp/license plate lampE. Tell-tale
A non-flashing green tell-tale to indicate the operation state of the position lamp shall be installed,
except that the instrument panel lighting can only be switched ON simultaneously with the
rear position lamp/license plate lamp

2. The luminous intensity shall meet the requirements under Subparagraph 2 in Table 6-11

Requirements for Installation and Luminous Intensity of Rear Position Lamp for Micro
Vehicle (Article 42 Subparagraph 3)

1. Installation requirementsA. Installation position1) Width
A) If one is installed, the reference point of the rear position lamp shall be positioned in the
median longitudinal plane of the micro vehicle
B) If two are installed, the reference point of the rear position lamps shall be positioned
symmetrically to the median longitudinal plane of the micro vehicle
C) If the vehicle has two wheels on left/right sides of rear axis and its width exceeds 1,300
mm, the extreme outer edge of the rear position lamps shall not be more than 400 mm from
the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.2) Height
Not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground

of not more than 15 degrees upwards, 15 degrees downwards. However, if the reference axis

2) If one is installed, the visibility of the rear position lamp shall be ensured in any angle of not

Requirements for Installation and Luminous Intensity of Stop Lamp for Micro Vehicle
(Article 43 Paragraph 1 Subparagraph 3)

1. Installation requirementsA. Installation position1) Width
A) If one is installed, the reference point of the stop lamp shall be positioned in the median
longitudinal plane of the micro vehicle
B) If two are installed, the reference point of the stop lamps shall be symmetrical to the median
longitudinal plane of the vehicle
C) If the vehicle has two wheels on left/right sides of rear axis and its width is not less than
1,300 mm, the distance between apparent surfaces of the stop lamp shall be not less than
600 mm
D) If the vehicle has two wheels on left/right sides of rear axis and its width is not more than
1,300 mm, the distance between apparent surfaces of the stop lamp shall be not less than
400 mm2) Height
Not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground
B. Observation angle
1) The visibility of the apparent surface of the stop lamp shall be ensured in any angle of not
more than 15 degrees upwards and 15 degrees downwards. However, if the reference axis of
the lamp is less than 750 mm above the ground, the visibility of the apparent surface shall be
ensured in any angle of not more than 15 degrees upwards and 5 degrees downwards
2) If one is installed, the visibility of the apparent surface of stop lamp shall be ensured in any
angle of not more than 45 degrees leftwards and rightwards
3) If two are installed, the visibility of the stop lamps shall be ensured in any angle of not more
than 45 degrees outwards, 10 degrees inwards
C. Orientation
The illuminating direction for the stop lamp shall be towards the rear of the vehicle
D. Operation requirements
The stop lamp shall be operated pursuant to Article 15 Paragraph 9 and Paragraph 10

Requirements for Installation and Luminous Intensity of Direction Indication Lamp for
Micro Vehicle (Article 44 Subparagraph 3)

1. Installation requirementsA. Installation position1) Width
A) The outer edge on the apparent surface of the direction indication lamp shall not be more
than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the micro vehicle
B) If the vehicle has one wheel on front axle or its width is not more than 1,000 mm, the
distance between the apparent surfaces of the front direction indication lamp shall be not
less than 240 mm
C) If the vehicle has two wheels on front axle or its width is not less than 1,000 mm, the
distance between the apparent surfaces of the front direction indication lamp shall be not
less than 500 mm
D) If the vehicle has one wheel on rear axle or its width is not more than 1,000 mm, the
distance between the apparent surfaces of the rear direction indication lamp shall be not
less than 180 mm
E) If the vehicle has two wheels on rear axle or its width is not less than 1,000 mm, the distance
between the apparent surfaces of the rear direction indication lamp shall be not less than
500 mm
F) The minimum luminous intensity of the front direction indication lamp according to the
minimum distance between the apparent surface of the passing beam headlamp and the
apparent surface of the front direction indication lamp shall be as below.
(1) If the minimum distance exceeds 75 mm, 90 cd or more
(2) If the minimum distance exceeds 40 mm, 175 cd or more
(3) If the minimum distance exceeds 20 mm, 250 cd or more
(4) If the minimum distance is 20 mm or less, 400 cd or more
2) Height
Not less than 500 mm and not more than 1,500 mm above the ground
B. Observation angle
1) The visibility of the apparent surface of the direction indication lamp shall be ensured in any
angle of not more than 15 degrees upwards, 15 degrees downwards. However, if the reference
axis of the direction indication lamp is less than 750 mm above the ground, the visibility of
the apparent surface shall be ensured in any angle of not more than 5 degrees downwards
2) The visibility of the apparent surface of direction indication lamp shall be ensured in any
angle of not more than 80 degrees outwards, 45 degrees inwards

1) The illuminating direction of the front direction indication lamp shall be towards the front of
the vehicle. However, it may move according to the angle of the steering wheel
2) The illuminating direction of the rear direction indication lamp shall be towards the rear of
the vehicle.D. Operation requirements
1) The direction indication lamp shall be structured to switch ON independently with other lamps.
2) The direction indication lamps on the one side of the micro vehicle shall be structured to
switch ON and OFF with one switchE. Tell-tale
1) A visual (green flashing tell-tale) or auditory or visual/auditory tell-tale to notify the operation
of the direction indication lamp shall be installed
2) In the event of malfunction of direction indication lamp, the direction indication lamp shall
be switched ON without a flashing or the direction indication lamp shall flash with a different
number of times specified in Item F' 1) or the tell-tale shall not be indicated.
3) If the auditory tell-tale is installed, it shall be the same as the flashing speed of the visual tell-
tale and provide a clear soundF. Other requirements
1) The direction indication lamp shall be a structure which flashes 90 ± 30 times per minute.
2) The direction indication lamps on each side may flash simultaneously or in rotation
3) Operation of the light-signal control shall be followed within not more than one second by
the emission of light and not more than one and one-half seconds by its first extinction.
4) In the event of malfunction other than disconnection, another direction indication lamp on
each side shall have a structure that it shall flash or switch ON. The number of flashing times
may be different than a number of times specified in Item F', 1).

Vehicle (Article 44-2 Subparagraph 2)

1. Installation requirementsA. Installation position
1) If the side-marker lamp is installed, it is sufficient to have one side-marker lamp fitted within
the first third and/or within the last third of the vehicle length.
2) Not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,500 mm above the ground
B. Observation angle

of not more than 10 degrees upwards and 10 degrees downwards. However, if the reference

installed, except that the instrument panel lighting can only be switched ON simultaneously
with the position lamp, rear position lamp, and license plate lamp

Requirements for Installation and Luminous Intensity of hazard warning lamp for Micro
Vehicle (Article 45 Subparagraph 2)

1. Operation requirements
A. The hazard warning lamp shall be operated by means of a separate manual control enabling all
the direction indication lamps to flash in phase.

45.

or the tell-tale for the direction indication lamp flashing on left and right simultaneously shall be

Installation and Reflection Requirements of Rear Retro-Reflector for Micro Vehicle
(Article 49 Paragraph 1 Subparagraph 3)

1. Installation requirements
A. Additional rear retro-reflectors are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of
the other light-signaling functions.
B. IA or IB type specified in Subparagraph 1 in Table 6-27 shall be installed
C. Installation position1) Width
A) If one is installed, the reference point of the rear retro-reflector shall be positioned in the
median longitudinal plane of the micro vehicle
B) If two are installed, the reference point of the rear retro-reflector shall be symmetrical to
the median longitudinal plane of the micro vehicle
C) If two are installed, the extreme outer edge of the apparent surface of the rear retro-reflector
shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the micro vehicle
2) Height
Not less than 250 mm and not more than 900 mm above the ground
D. Observation angle
1) The visibility of the apparent surface of the rear retro-reflector shall be ensured in any angle
of not more than 10 degrees upwards, 10 degrees downwards. However, if the reference axis
of the lamp is less than 750 mm above the ground, the visibility of the apparent surface shall
be ensured in any angle of not more than 5 degrees downwards
2) For the single lamp, the apparent surface of rear retro-reflector shall be ensured in any angle
of not more than 30 degrees for leftward and rightward. If two are installed, the visibility of
the apparent surface of rear retro-reflector shall be ensured not more than 30 degrees outwards,
30 degrees inwardsE. Orientation
The illuminating direction of the rear retro-reflector shall be towards the rear of the vehicle.
F. Other requirements
The illuminating surface of the retro-reflector may be shared with the apparent surface of red
lighting devices installed at the rear of the vehicle

2. The reflection shall meet the requirements under Subparagraph 1 in Table 6-27

Requirements for Installation of Side Retro-Reflector for Micro Vehicle
(Article 49 Paragraph 4 Subparagraph 3)

1. Installation requirementsA. Arrangements
1) It is sufficient to have IA, IB side retro-reflector specified in Subparagraph 1 of Table 6-27

be ensured in any angle of not more than 5 degrees downwards
2) The visibility of single lamp shall be ensured in any angle of not more than 45 degrees forward
and rearward

Installation and Field of View Criteria for Indirect Vision Device for Micro Vehicle
(Article 50 Paragraph 1 Subparagraph 1)

1. Installation requirements
A. Rearview mirrors or camera-monitor system (CMS) shall be applied to the indirect vision device
of the micro vehicle
B. One for exterior rear-view class III pursuant to Subparagraph 1 Item C in Table 5-7 (It may be
substituted with exterior rear-view class II, pursuant to Subparagraph 1 Item B in Table 5-7, only
for the passenger's side) or the one for motorcycle rear-view device pursuant to Subparagraph 1
Item G in Table 5-7 shall be installed to each of driver's side and passenger's side of micro
vehicle.
C. Interior rear-view device, pursuant to Subparagraph 1 Item A in Table 5-7, may be installed in
the micro vehicle.
D. If CMS is applied as the indirect vision device of micro vehicle, it shall meet the requirements
specified in Table 5-8

2. Requirements for field of vision
A. Exterior rear-view class II shall meet the requirements specified in Table 5-7 Subparagraph 1
Item B, and exterior rear-view class III shall meet the requirements specified in Table 5-7
Subparagraph 1 Item C
B. Motorcycle rear-view device which can be fitted in the micro vehicle shall meet the requirements
specified in Table 5-7 Subparagraph 1 Item G

3. Impact test
A. The reflecting surface shall not break during the tests, except the following conditions
1) The fragments of glass still adhere or projecting part shall not exceed 2.5 mm.
2) The reflecting surface is made of safety glass.
B. Motorcycle rear-view device which can be fitted in the micro vehicle
1) All its parts including the support, which is in potential static contact with a sphere 100 mm
in diameter, shall have a radius of curvature "c" of not less than 2.5 mm. However, except the
edges of fixing holes or recesses, which are not more than 12 mm in width.
2) If the rear-view mirror is on impact by the pendulum impact rig with a mass of 6.8 kg, the
mirror surface shall not break.
3) The test loading (25 kg) be applied to exterior rear-view mirror by a static bending test rig for
one minute, and the mirror surface shall not break.
4) Notwithstanding 2) and 3), protruded part shall be not more than 2.5 mm if the mirror surface
has brokenC. The lens of camera monitor system shall not break

4. General requirements
A. Indirect vision device using mirrors shall be adjustable.
B. Pursuant to Subparagraph 2, field of view through the side windows or through the portion of
the windscreen that is swept by the windscreen wiper

5. Mirror based devices for indirect vision shall meet the size and radius pursuant to
Subparagraph 4 in Table 5-7
